title: HLC overflow handled correctly without integer overflow risk
description:
## Decision
crates/core/src/hlc.rs handles HLC overflow by bumping wall_ms when logical_count would overflow u16. The skew check uses (ts.wall_ms - now_ms) rather than (ts.wall_ms + MAX_SKEW_MS) to avoid addition overflow. The new_seeded() function ensures monotonicity after restart by reading the persisted HLC and advancing past it.
